title: Clark Hunt "very supportive" of more international games, 18-game season to facilitate that

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Clark Hunt "very supportive" of more international games, 18-game season to facilitate that
sources.description: The NFL's push to play more games overseas, and to expand the regular season to 18 games, go hand-in-hand in the view of Chiefs owner Clark Hunt.
